title: A machine learning model predicts stroke associated with blood cadmium level.
summary: Using NHANES 2013–2014 data from 2,664 adults, five classifiers were trained/tested to identify stroke from measured features including blood cadmium. Logistic regression performed best for the blood-cadmium-based model (AUC .800); cadmium quartiles and stroke showed an observational association.
ai_technology: Five classifiers, including logistic regression and random forest, with SHAP feature interpretation.
